highlights.title: My Agents down the left of an agent's page
highlights.line: In a wide window, an agent's page lists every agent down the left, starred first. Click one to move to it, or fold the list to avatars.

highlights.title: Kosmos says when two copies of an agent run
highlights.line: An agent's card and page say when two sessions are running it at once, and hovering names the other session.

highlights.title: See when an agent sits on one step
highlights.line: The hover on a Claude agent's card and its page say when it has been on one tool call for five minutes or more, and which tool.

highlights.title: Task counts say built, done and dropped
highlights.line: A parent task's count now shows built, done and dropped apart, on the Tasks view, in its project and on its page.

highlights.title: Added agents keep their account and model
highlights.line: An agent you add from Found agents stays on the Claude account and model it was using, and Kosmos says if it could not.
